# Ohio Pride PAC

> Ohio Pride is Ohio's only statewide LGBTQ+ PAC. We endorse pro-equality candidates, mobilize voters, and fight anti-LGBTQ+ legislation in the Ohio Statehouse. Registered with the Ohio Secretary of State. "Ohio Pride" in general use, "Ohio Pride PAC" in formal and legal contexts.

## Brand

- [Brand reference](https://ohiopride.org/brand): logo system, color, typography, voice, social playbook, compliance rules.
- [brand.json](https://ohiopride.org/brand.json): machine-readable tokens, asset URLs, and content rules. Read this before producing any Ohio Pride graphic or copy.
- [Wordmark, primary on navy (SVG)](https://ohiopride.org/assets/logo/wordmark-primary-on-navy.svg): use the official asset, never rebuild it from type.
- [Endorsed badge, white (PNG)](https://ohiopride.org/assets/logo/endorsed-by-ohio-pride-white.png): for endorsed candidates only.

## Non-negotiables for anyone writing or designing for Ohio Pride

- Say "only statewide LGBTQ+ PAC." Never "first."
- Say "out," never "openly."
- No em dashes or en dashes. Use periods, commas, colons, semicolons.
- Organization copy uses "we."
- Navy #152233 fields, Light Blue #70D6EC accents, Montserrat ExtraBold headlines, Roboto Slab body.
- The Progress Pride gradient is an accent device (thin bars, tags), never a background and never inside the wordmark.
- Organic social graphics and captions carry no disclaimer. Paid, mail, and print carry "Paid for by Ohio Pride PAC."
- Message to persuadable independents. Warm, neighbors not activists, receipts not rage.
